impact: Generalizing the discern_next_of_kin.json finding: this repo has a recurring bug class where a post-hoc script mutates already-generated JSON artifacts (license retrofit, raw_tokens enrichment) that the ORIGINAL GENERATOR's struct has no knowledge of. The generator's struct is never updated to carry the retrofitted field, so any future re-run of that generator silently regresses the artifact back to its pre-retrofit shape -- and nothing fails, because verify.sh asserts shape/build health, not field-level round-trip survival of a prior enrichment pass. Same shape likely recurs elsewhere per team-lead (hardcoded debt allowlist, stale scope register, a book roster that never grew) -- worth a named check, not treated as a one-off. Separately: the ONLY reason this was caught is that the brief required proving the regeneration mechanically as a no-op and reporting a non-flag-change count as a hard number; a brief that said 'regenerate and make sure verify.sh is green' would have shipped the compliance regression silently.
resolution: no code changed this cycle by design (team-lead directed diagnosis-only, no fix); remedy deferred to team-lead pending reconciliation with wiring-class-generator's in-flight scope
